name: nvidia-nim-agent
description: Use NVIDIA NIM reasoning models in GitHub Copilot Chat for VS Code

languageModelTools.name: nvidia_nim_analyze_image
languageModelTools.userDescription: Analyze an image with a NVIDIA NIM vision model.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze an image, describe its contents, extract text, or answer a question about visual content.

prompt.description: The question or instruction about the image.

nvidia-nim.fallback.enabled.description: Enable automatic failover to a fallback model when the primary model fails.

nvidia-nim.fallback.model.description: Model to switch to when the primary model encounters a fatal error or rate limit.

nvidia-nim.fallback.onRateLimit.description: Trigger fallback on rate limits or server overload (HTTP 429 / 529).

nvidia-nim.fallback.onModelUnavailable.description: Trigger fallback if the model is temporarily disabled or unavailable on the server (HTTP 404).

nvidia-nim.fallback.onEmptyStream.description: Trigger fallback if the model returns an empty stream after retry attempts.

nvidia-nim.fallback.onTimeout.description: Trigger fallback if the stream idle timeout is exceeded.

nvidia-nim.fallback.firstTokenTimeoutSec.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the first response token (TTFT) before triggering fallback. If null, standard stream timeout applies.

nvidia-nim.fallback.showNoticeInChat.description: Display a markdown notice callout in chat explaining that a fallback model was used.

nvidia-nim.fallback.notifyUser.description: Show a VS Code notification message when fallback occurs.

nvidia-nim.network.streamIdleTimeout.description: Maximum idle time in seconds between streamed chunks before timing out.

nvidia-nim.network.maxHttpRetries.description: Maximum HTTP retry attempts on transient network errors and 429/502/503/504 status codes.

nvidia-nim.network.maxEmptyStreamRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts before failing or triggering fallback when a model returns no content.

nvidia-nim.reasoning.mode.description: Configure the default reasoning effort mode sent to supported models.

nvidia-nim.reasoning.showInChat.description: Show model reasoning content (thinking process) in responses.

nvidia-nim.generation.temperature.description: Override temperature for generation (null uses model adapter default).

nvidia-nim.generation.topP.description: Override Top-P sampling parameter (null uses model default).

nvidia-nim.generation.maxOutputTokens.description: Override maximum output tokens limit per response (null uses model maximum).

nvidia-nim.tools.autoRepairArguments.description: Automatically repair stringified JSON, missing quotes, and malformed tool call arguments.

nvidia-nim.tools.autoRetryInvalidCalls.description: Send a system correction prompt when the model produces invalid or unfixable tool arguments.

nvidia-nim.tools.suppressDuplicateReads.description: Suppress duplicate consecutive identical read-only tool calls.

nvidia-nim.context.autoCompactOnOverflow.description: Automatically compact older conversation turns with summarization on context overflow (HTTP 400).

nvidia-nim.context.summarizationModel.description: Dedicated lightweight model used for compacting and summarizing conversation history.

nvidia-nim.context.safetyMarginPercent.description: Percentage of context window reserved as a safety buffer for tokenizer estimation variance.

nvidia-nim.ui.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the NVIDIA NIM status bar item and token breakdown in VS Code.

nvidia-nim.developer.debugLogging.description: Enable verbose debug logging of requests, SSE chunks, and internal operations.

nvidia-nim.developer.logTimingBreakdowns.description: Log detailed generation timing and speed metrics (tokens/sec, TTFT, durations).
